# telnyx_porting_order_phone_number_extension (Resource)

A range of extensions of a phone number in a porting order.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `activation_ranges` (Attributes List) Specifies the activation ranges for this porting phone number extension. The activation range must be within the extension range and should not overlap with other activation ranges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--activation_ranges))
- `extension_range` (Attributes) Specifies the extension range for this porting phone number extension. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--extension_range))
- `porting_order_id` (String) The porting order id.
- `porting_phone_number_id` (String) Identifies the porting phone number associated with this porting phone number extension.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies this porting phone number extension.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--activation_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `activation_ranges`

Required:

- `end_at` (Number) Specifies the end of the activation range. It must be no more than the end of the extension range.
- `start_at` (Number) Specifies the start of the activation range. Must be greater or equal the start of the extension range.


<a id="nestedatt--extension_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `extension_range`

Required:

- `end_at` (Number) Specifies the end of the extension range for this porting phone number extension.
- `start_at` (Number) Specifies the start of the extension range for this porting phone number extension.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_porting_order_phone_number_extension.example <porting_order_id>/<id>
```
